title: Transient conjugate heat transfer in internally heated ceramic pebble beds: pore-resolved reference fields and graph–Transformer prediction
description: Reproducible inputs, processing programs, compact figure data and selected predictions for pore-resolved conjugate heat transfer and reduced-order modeling of internally heated ceramic pebble beds.
